s.note: the bears catching salmon at the salmon run
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with cream cheese. Top with folds of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Squeeze over a little lemon and lay them on a wooden board. Fresh from the salmon run.

Toss 150g pecans and 150g walnuts with 4 tbsp maple syrup and a pinch of salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool until set and break into clusters. Take off, eh, they are good.

m.note: the hunt before Kenai becomes a bear
m.how: Parboil 1kg potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes, toss with oil, rosemary and salt and roast at 220C for 45 minutes. Bring 4 venison steaks to room temperature, oil and season. Sear in a very hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side for rare and rest 5 minutes. Add 150ml beef stock, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, 150g blueberries, 1 tbsp brown sugar and a thyme sprig to the pan and simmer 5 minutes until syrupy, then whisk in 20g butter. Slice the venison and spoon over the sauce.

w.note: the honey and berries the bears love
w.how: Toss 500g mixed berries with 3 tbsp honey and spread in a dish. Rub 100g butter into oats, flour and 80g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until bubbling and serve with cream.

d.note: the spirits lighting up the sky as the northern lights
d.how: Simmer 150g blueberries with 80g caster sugar and 80ml water for 5 minutes, then strain and cool. Mix the juice of 4 lemons with 2 tbsp of the syrup and 400ml cold water. Fill 4 glasses with ice, a few mint leaves and blueberries. Pour in the lemonade, then spoon the rest of the blueberry syrup over the top and finish with a splash of soda water.
